high_level_description: This image is a comic strip featuring two characters: a large, muscular dragon-like creature and a human figure. Characters: Dragon-like Creature: This character has a large, muscular body with scales, horns, and sharp teeth. It appears to be crying, with tears streaming down its face. The creature is standing on a rocky surface, possibly a cave entrance. Human Figure: This character is shirtless, wearing a loincloth and boots, and holding a sword. He stands on the same rocky surface as the dragon-like creature. His expression is one of surprise or shock
